column3: “anyone’s body” renders “the flesh of a man (adam).”
“a layman” renders “a stranger (zar),” and “his people” renders “his kinsmen.”
“an equal part of each” renders “part for part.”
“very fine” renders an emphatic doubled verb; “most holy” renders “holiness of holinesses.”
“to use as perfume” renders “to smell it,” and “his people” renders “his kinsmen.”
